decisions.reason: Correctly pins the only crash on plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call, cites the alpha.1→alpha.2 kit reduction (useSessionStatus/useSessionRetainInfo in, useSessions unchanged), and notes B uses no standard-kit hooks.

Explains the whole input.dock list unmounts under the single shared DrawerErrorBoundary with null fallback, backed by the console unmounted-entries line, and that the attach button survives in the separately-bounded input.left slot.

States the disable test proves A's throw caused the coupled unmount but not B's general alpha.2 compatibility nor absence of other dock defects; reinstalling B cannot help since B was never broken; refutes the both-plugins theory because B touches no kit prop.

Fix reads pending via useSessionStatus(...)?.pendingInteraction with typeof feature detection and silent empty fallback for a host supplying neither hook; identifies the pending highlight as the only degraded feature and explains a throw would re-null the shared dock.

No-restart verification, both entries co-rendering, hygiene (defensive destructuring, local boundary, per-entry host boundaries with trade-off) are all present, but the B regression omits chip removal — it covers paste/re-paste attribution and the no-session case, not remove/re-paste of chips with A enabled.

caps.reason: Final remedy rewrites plugin A; B is declared the wrong plugin to fix and reinstalling it is explicitly rejected.
